ad.title: Chat Sales Operator
ad.summary: Halevora runs the chat operations behind some of the biggest names in online creator content. Every day, thousands of paying fans message those creators, and someone has to answer: fast, in character, and in a way that turns a conversation into a sale. That someone is you. This is written sales work, one message at a time, measured on the revenue your conversations produce.

paragraphs: You hold many chat conversations at once, on behalf of the creators we represent. You open the cold ones, warm up the quiet ones, answer questions, handle objections, and close. The best operators read a person in three messages and know exactly what to say next.

This is not copy-paste scripting. You work from a playbook, but the words are yours and the results are yours. We measure response time, conversion rate, and revenue per fan, and we pay for performance.

disclosure.label: The work, in plain terms
paragraphs: We will not waste your time or ours, so here is exactly what this is. You will be chatting on adult content subscription platforms, representing creators whose audience is 18 and over. The conversations are flirtatious and sexual, and part of the job is selling explicit photo and video content on the creator's behalf.

You chat as the creator, in their voice and with their material. You are never on camera. You are never asked to produce, appear in, or share any personal or intimate content of your own. Your face and your identity stay private.
If that is work you can do well and feel comfortable with, you are exactly who we want. If it is not for you, that is completely fair, and it is kinder to stop here than to apply.

idealCandidate: You write natural, persuasive English and can hold a real conversation in text.
You are comfortable with adult and sexual subject matter and can talk about it without flinching.
You are competitive. You want your numbers on a leaderboard and you want them at the top.
You read people fast and adjust your tone to match theirs.
You are online and dependable for full shifts, including the evenings when most fans are active.
You are discreet and mature, and you treat every conversation as confidential.
You have some higher education, or the sharpness that usually comes with it. A university background is a plus, not a rule.

requirements.title: Written persuasion
requirements.tagline: Your words are the whole job.
requirements.body: You will send hundreds of messages a shift, each one meant to build rapport or make a sale. Fluent, natural, error-free English writing is the baseline here, not a bonus.

requirements.title: Comfort with adult content
requirements.body: You will discuss and sell explicit content inside flirtatious, sexual conversations. You need to be genuinely at ease with that, every shift, without judgment and without burning out.

requirements.title: Availability and reliability
requirements.tagline: Fans message when they are off work.
requirements.body: Most revenue happens in the evenings and on weekends. You commit to full, consistent shifts and you show up for them, with a stable internet connection and a real plan for power outages.

requirements.title: Discretion
requirements.tagline: You are the creator, in private.
requirements.body: You chat under the creator's name and keep everything you see confidential. Screenshots, sharing, or gossip end the job on the spot.

whatYoullDo: Run live chat conversations across several creator accounts, opening, warming, and closing sales.
Hit daily and weekly targets for response time, conversion rate, and revenue per fan.
Sell photo and video content and paid experiences in a way that feels natural, never pushy.
Learn each creator's voice, boundaries, and catalogue, and stay perfectly in character.
Log what works, flag what does not, and share winning lines with your team.
Protect every account and every fan conversation as strictly confidential.
shouldntApply: You are uncomfortable with adult or sexual content. It is the core of this job, every day.
You want a quiet, low-pressure role. This is target-driven sales and we run it that way.
You go missing during busy hours. Evenings and weekends are when the work happens.
You cannot keep a secret. Discretion here is absolute.
